title: Article export and CMS writes require original owner post provenance
steps: Run the deterministic production export and write boundary regressions with rejected and valid frozen inputs.
expect: A failed-best article cannot reach the CMS through export, even if planner checks already reported its error.
Frozen plan and actual writer citations must cite the same original post; valid articles and generic trade copy still write.
fence: Preserve frozen research and plan inputs; refuse unsupported content before uploads or CMS writes.

tests: a failed article citing service is omitted before export and real CMS write
authentic original article and generic trade copy still export and reach the actual write door
